Practical expertise.

A Singapore-based practice bringing together professional training, workplace safety, environmental and audit services.

Our story

Stronger systems.
More capable people.

APJ Certification was established by D. Prabhu to support organisations through auditing and internal and external training.

APJ CERTIFICATION is a Auditing, Internal and External Training company based in Singapore established by D.Prabhu With more than 15 years of experience, we are dedicated to provide Workplace Safety & Health, Environmental and Audit services to various industries.

APJ’s  Auditors are highly qualified as WSH professionals; each having Bachelor degree in the field of engineering, safety and health; specialist diplomas in occupational safety and health through recognized educational institutions.

Complaints

Explore APJ’s approach to professional training, auditing and certification services.

APJ CERT shall be responsible for all decisions at all levels of the complaints handling process. Submission, investigation and decision on complaints shall not result in any discriminatory actions against the complaint. Upon receipt of a complaint, the APJ CERT shall confirm whether the complaint relates to the auditing activities that it is responsible for and, if so, shall deal with it.

If the complaint relates to an audited client, then examination of the complaint shall consider the effectiveness of the audited management system.
Any valid complaint about an audited client shall also be referred by APJ CERT to the audited client in question at an appropriate time

APJ CERT have a documented process to receive, evaluate and make decisions on complaints. This process shall be subject to requirements for confidentiality, as it relates to the complainant and to the subject of the complaint

The complaint handling process shall include at least the following elements and methods

  1. An outline of the process for receiving, validating, investigating the complaint, and for deciding what actions need to be taken in response to it
  2. Tracking and recording complaints, including actions undertaken in response to them
  3. Ensuring that any appropriate correction and corrective action are taken

APJ CERT shall be responsible for gathering and verifying all necessary information to validate the complaint. Whenever possible, APJ CERT shall acknowledge receipt of the complaint and shall provide the complaint with progress reports and the result of the complaint.

The decision to be communicated to the complainant shall be made by or reviewed and approved by, individual (s) not previously involved in the subject of the complaint. Whenever possible, the APJ CERT shall give formal notice of the end of the complaints-handling process to the complainant.

APJ CERT shall determine, together with the audited client and the complainant, whether and, if so to what extent, the subject of the complaint and its resolution shall be made public.

Impartiality Policy

Explore APJ’s approach to professional training, auditing and certification services.

It is the policy of APJ to operate its business in accordance with the guidance principles of impartiality, competence, responsibility, openness, confidentiality and responsiveness. APJ views the safeguarding of impartiality as paramount in maintaining confidence in APJ audit services. APJ senior management has established and promoted an impartiality policy with associated objectives on which APJ service will be based. APJ’s management is committed for managing conflict of interest, in case there is any, and brings objectivity to the audit process.

 A relationship that threatens APJ’s impartiality can be based upon ownership, governance, personnel, shared resources, finances, contracts, marketing and payment of a sales commission or other inducement for the referral of new clients etc. APJ’s top management is committed to impartiality in its management system audit services. All Director , staff and sub-contractors are required to complete and sign the Compliance with Conflict of Interest Form.

 In order to remain impartial APJ always strives to;

 Constantly educate and make all staff members aware of all possible threats of conflict of interest that can arise during verification

Continuously monitor and identify possible threats to our impartiality and guard against such threats

Report such threats to authorities responsible for taking further actions, both internally and externally

Ensure that all management and staff are aware of the confidentiality agreement APJ has with the clients

Empower management staff to take immediate actions against any staff or client who act in a way that undermines APJ’s position on impartiality

Demand that all staff declare any relationship that they may have which can result in breaching the conduct on impartiality and or confidentiality with clients or business partners

Constantly provide APJ staff with necessary support in reporting and cooperating with authorities when reporting incident(s) which are threats to APJ’s impartiality
